notes: Desktop/puck-style unit; not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). LS425 and LS445 share identical physical I/O; they differ only in video decode capability (LS425 = Full HD 1080p60; LS445 = 4K). HDMI is HDMI 2.0a per BrightSign's official spec sheets (multiple corroborating retailer sources) — mapped to grade hdmi-2.0 since 2.0a is an HDR/metadata revision, not a bandwidth change. USB-C port supports host mode plus adapter cables for GPIO/serial/IR (bidirectional, USB spec version not stated by BrightSign — omitted grade rather than guess). Ethernet is 10/100 (Fast Ethernet), graded eth-100m. Optional Wi-Fi/Bluetooth module (WD-105) connects via internal M.2 E-key slot, not an external port, so it is not listed as physical I/O; the two external antenna connectors for that optional module were also omitted since they are RF antenna jacks, not in the provided connector list. Power is a locking DC barrel-style connector rated 12V/1.5A (BrightSign-proprietary locking variant of dc-barrel).

ports.name: HDMI Out
ports.note: HDMI 2.0a per BrightSign spec; outputs up to 1920x1080 at 60p on LS425

ports.name: USB-C
ports.note: Host-mode capable; supports adapter cables for GPIO, RS-232 serial, and IR

ports.name: Audio Out
ports.note: 3.5mm analog audio out; same jack also carries S/PDIF digital audio

ports.name: microSD
ports.note: microSD card slot for primary storage; no exact connector id available in the allowed list, closest analog omitted from confidence-critical mapping — physical slot is a microSD card reader, not a cable connector
